recommendation: Resolve the contact-capture defects before native admission or merge.

findings.title: Use one coordinate frame for contact classification
findings.body: The environment subtracts terrain.env_origins from link poses at line 409, then passes world contact_pos_w without that subtraction. At a 2 m replica offset, the same valid toe point changes from inside to outside the cap. Offset replicas can report shaft contact and fail standing admission.

findings.title: Retain each contact patch for the existing nonfoot gate
findings.body: The task classifies the total tibia force from one average contact point. The installed PhysX ContactSensorData documents contact_pos_w as the average position of contact points. A toe and shaft contact can average into the toe cap and hide the shaft load. The frozen prototype classifies each patch and retains any nonfoot patch above 1 N before summing forces. The new capture needs those raw patch semantics to claim the unchanged gate.

next_step_proposal.implementation_scope: Use new task and controller modules in packages/hexapod_env; preserve experiments/paper_walk, existing tests and published manifests. Start with a reference-only pilot, then the approved equal-budget residual PPO pilot after its original screens pass.
next_step_proposal.consequential_gap: At a stop request, selecting the zero-command table row returns neutral at once and can bypass the planned plant phase. The implementation must retain the prior motion reference through touchdown, verify measured support, then freeze phase. A geometric zero swing height alone does not prove six-foot contact. The partner consultation remains incomplete; no new controller decision is adopted here.
